d:
Presenting the divine shabad “Sabhe Ghat Ram Bole” in the soulful voice of Bhai Harjinder Singh Ji Sri Nagar Wale.
Sarab Sanjhi Gurbani tuhade layi le ke aundi hai Nitnem, Japji Sahib, Jaap Sahib, Rehras Sahib, Ardas te Kirtan Sohila di roohani bani. Ithe tusi non-stop Gurbani, Shabad Kirtan te paath sun sakde ho jo tuhanu Waheguru naal jodda hai.
Is channel te prasidh ragi jathian, Bhaiji's te Punjabi gayakan walon Gurbani paath, katha te shabad kirtan miluga. Rozana Nitnem, dhyaan layi shaant Gurbani ya mann nu shanti den wali kirtan — sab kujh ithe uplabdh hai.
